messages.en: What are you doing?
I came to LA.
I'm watching a yellowtail sashimi mukbang.
I can't take it.
My algorithm right now...
is showing me nothing but mukbangs of seasonal Korean seafood.
It's driving me crazy.
Coming to LA reminds me of...
when we went to Six Flags.
I remember it now.
I wanna go again.
Anyway, I have so many photos piled up...
There's a huge backlog.
When am I ever going to send them all..
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
I'll send them soon.
I've been eating so much delicious food lately
that I'm putting on weight.
It's driving me crazy.
I should go work out today, too.
I work out alone.
I feel like having someone around would distract me.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Tell us your workout routine.
I usually do...
40 minutes on the treadmill and 30 minutes of strength training.
I only do strength training for my lower body,
I'm not supposed to train my upper body.
I'm seriously going to debut as an athlete.
Are you trying to get more solid and sturdy??
I'm trying to get huge and muscular.
Are you going to become a ssireum wrestler?
Hey, hey.
You need to be heavy for that.
Still, while we're on tour,
thanks to the performances,
I get plenty of exercise.
I'm choosing what to eat ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋ
I just stepped out into the hallway for a moment,
and I forgot to bring my key.
Chaewon won't open the door because she's showering.
Forced to live on the streets.
This is driving me crazy.
What if she's actually done showering but just won't open the door?
Oh, maybe she wanted the room to herself.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
I guess I'll have to scratch at the door.
This is driving me crazy.
I keep forgetting my room key,
so I have to wait until Chaewon comes back,
or make sure she's already inside the room.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ Is there no option where you just don't forget your key?
I'm working on it..
I'll get the photos approved as quickly as I can
and release them soon.
Then at least give us today's song recommendation.
No, I want to receive song recommendations.

messages.ko: 나 공항에서나 씻을때나 노래 계속 들어서
messages.en: I keep listening to music at the airport and even when I'm showering,
so now I have nothing left to listen to.
I even saved all the songs recommended to me last time
through Cosmo Talk,
under a playlist called Hexagon Playlist.
I saved every single one.
I've listened to all of those, too.
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You recommended so many songs,
but I've listened to them all.
Since we spend so much time traveling,
I even watched three Netflix dramas
and finished all of them.
I downloaded them on the plane.

messages.ko: 백일의 거짓말 봤어?? 요즘 안 보는 사람이 없더라 (난안봤어ㅎㅎ)
messages.en: Have you watched One Hundred Lies?? It feels like everyone is watching it these days (I haven't watched it though hehe).
That one, True Education, and Sweet Part-Time Job.
True Education is a good one, I agree.

messages.ko: 먼가 하연이 대장님이라 나화진st 잘 어울릴듯
messages.en: Somehow, since Hayeon's such a boss, I think you'd suit a Na Hwa-jin kind of role.
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Watching that,
I started wondering if I should learn how to fight, too.
That's what I thought.
My weapon for surviving in this world.
That's the kind of vibe.
Let's establish the Hexagon Protection Agency.
If you report something to me,
I'll rush over
and fight for you.
There's no guarantee I'll win, though.
You'll also have to cover Hayeon's medical bills.
I can guarantee things like yelling at them
or taking a hit for you.
Those services are guaranteed.
Since I have a profession,
if I get hit in the face, you'll have to pay double the medical expenses.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ

messages.ko: 나 진짜 무서운 영화나 드라마 보고싶은데
messages.en: I really want to watch a scary movie or drama,
so recommend something for me.
Have you watched Obsession?
Where can I watch that?
That's the one Nakyoung keeps talking about all the time ㅋ
Exactly, unnie talks about it all the time,
but I don't even know what it's about.
It doesn't show up on Netflix!?
Oh, so I have to buy it.
I can't watch it because Nakyoung spoiled it for me.
I think I've already heard about the important scenes, too.
Please recommend some Roblox horror maps!!
You know, Jiwoo unnie and I are always playing
Don't Swim,
but now Jiwoo unnie is better at Roblox than I am.
I keep dying.
All the Roblox skills I've built up since elementary school...
To think they're being so brutally crushed by natural talent.
Ask Jiwoo to teach you ㅋㅋㅋ
Now, now.
I have the pride of a veteran player to uphold.
You cleared Can't Make It Up the Hill, right?
I think I just accepted that I was a little kid and gave up.
Jiwoo unnie was just so good at it.
There's a skill you can buy with real money that lets you push people,
and I considered buying it.
No, I don't spend money on Roblox.
The only games I've ever spent money on are...
a little on the old MapleStory,
and a little on Overwatch skins.
That's it.
Boooo, you spent money on Overwatch skins!
WHAT!!!!!!
So what!!!
It's my money!!!

messages.ko: 난 내 가족 나 Y/n 아니면 돈 안써
messages.en: I only spend money on my family and Y/n.
Games are purely for my own enjoyment,

messages.ko: Y/n이 로블럭스 10만원짜리 날개하나 산다해도 사줄수 있어!!!
messages.en: and even if Y/n wanted a 100,000-won pair of wings in Roblox, I'd buy it for them!!!
Seriously, could you buy it for me??
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ You sound so serious, it's cute.
Even if there were only 100 people, that would be 10 million won.
Wait a second...
Can I correct myself..? hehe
1000 won…? hehe
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Wait, before Hayeon's food gets here,
I need to go to the gym.
Are you still homeless?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
She opened the door.
Oh, should I eat first before going?
What did you order?
Meat~~
Steak.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'll enjoy every bite.
Honestly, I'm so hungry I feel like I'm going crazy.
Is that Chaewon?
It's me.
I guess our voices really do sound alike.
Everyone keeps getting us mixed up.
I'm more used to Hayeon-chan's slightly more 'Teto' voice.
Okay.
Like this?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋ
Have a nice day,
I'm gonna eat, work out, shower, and then pass out.
Byebye.
Haranghae❤️❤️
